array-object-identities:
<?php
class A {} class B {}
$a=new A; $b=new A; $c=new B;
$x=[$a,$b,$c]; $y=$x; $a=null;
echo $x[0] === $y[0] ? 'I' : 'N';
echo $x[0] === $x[1] ? 'I' : 'N';
echo $x[0] == $x[1] ? 'E' : 'N';
echo $x[0] == $x[2] ? 'E' : 'N';
class-typed-identity:
<?php
class A {}
function identity(A $x): A { return $x; }
$a=new A; echo identity($a) === $a ? 'I' : 'N';
conditional-function-publication:
<?php
function publish() { class C {} }
if (false) { class Hidden {} }
publish();
$a = new C;
echo $a instanceof C ? 'C' : 'N';
echo $a instanceof Hidden ? 'H' : 'N';
echo $a instanceof Unknown ? 'U' : 'N';
conditional-redeclare:
<?php
function publish() { class C {} }
publish(); echo 'A'; publish(); echo 'B';
instanceof-nonobjects:

$x=1;
echo $x instanceof Missing ? 'T' : 'F';
echo $undefined instanceof Missing ? 'T' : 'F';
instance-foreach-empty:
<?php
class A {} foreach (new A as $key => $value) echo 'unexpected'; echo 'empty';

instance-callable-array-type:

instance-wrong-class-type:

instance-union-class-callable:
<?php

namespace-alias-early:
<?php
namespace N;
use N\C as Alias;
$a = new Alias;
$b = new C;
class C {}
echo $a === $b ? 'same' : 'distinct';
echo $a == $b ? 'equal' : 'unequal';
echo $a instanceof Alias ? 'yes' : 'no';
